LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: MATHEMATICAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: MEASUREMENT
Topic 2.1: Length
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Length, part of MEASUREMENT in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three MATHEMATICAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why do we measure the distances? 2. How do you determine total lengths?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Length together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: learner uses digital devices to record videos of classmates measuring length.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: learner works out questions involving addition of length in real life situations.

Values:
● Unity: learner appreciates peers’ effort as they measure the lengths of various objects in and around the classroom.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Self-efficacy: learner estimates distances around the school compound up to 10 metres, measure the actual distances and

compare results.

● Social cohesion: learner works harmoniously with peers to estimate distances around the school compound.

Link to other learning areas:

● The learner is able to relate skills used in preparing 5 metres long strings with knots at intervals of one metre to

weaving skills in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning resources:

Books, pencils, rulers, sticks, bottles, metre rule, metre sticks, digital devices, strings, digital devices with assistive

technology such as screen readers, screen magnifiers and tactile keyboards.
